title: Company Profile Lookup Input
description: Input for the company-profile-lookup Brick. Supplies a company URL or domain and a target ICP for downstream qualification.

company_url.description: Company URL or domain. The Brick accepts HTTP(S) URLs and bare domains, performs strict deterministic hostname normalization, and never performs network access.

target_icp.description: Free-text ideal-customer-profile description, passed through unchanged. The downstream qualifier requires recognized descriptors for industry, segment, and audience. Unrecognized connecting words are ignored. See SUPPORTED_ICP_VOCABULARY.md.

notes.description: Optional notes, passed through unchanged and excluded from v0.1 scoring. Omission and explicit null are both accepted.
